title: Keep code tidy (commercial Mandate 93), in the active contract
goal: Vision: V-18. Directive 2026-11-16: agents must keep code tidy. The rule lands in core's active contract beside the panic-path and lint-allowance rules: rustfmt and Clippy -D warnings on what a change affects before publishing; no new debt (allowances say why, markers name their task, no commented-out code); a file over 2,000 lines grows by at most 25 lines; nothing dead; follow the crate's patterns; clear debt you meet in its own commit. Clippy's dbg_macro is denied workspace-wide. Pinned in tests/architecture_tests.rs.

reuse.searched: Inside Susi: the active contract already denies panic-path macros and requires inline lint justifications; crates/susi-gawd/src/bloat_audit.rs inventories oversized functions, unwraps, clones and markers over the socket; the commercial workflow code verb (susi-commercial-apps Mandate 93) reports markers, dead source and the change's growth and allowances. The pinned toolchain's rustfmt and Clippy hold formatting and lints; dbg_macro is denied here instead of new code.
